EDUCATION 
BBA, University of Calicut 
(2012 – 2015) 
CERTIFICATIONS 
– Certified Professional Sales 
Leader (CPSL), Sales 
Management Association (2021) 
LANGUAGES 
English (fluent) 
Malayalam (native) 
Tamil (conversational) 
PROFILE 
Results-driven sales professional with 9 years of experience in 
FMCG distribution, including 4 years leading a regional sales 
team of 8. Consistently exceeded quarterly revenue targets and 
built processes that improved lead conversion and account 
retention across a competitive regional market. 
EXPERIENCE 
Regional Sales Manager — Meridian FMCG Distributors, 
Kozhikode 
Apr 2022 – Present 
• Manage a team of 8 sales executives across the Malabar region, 
covering 400+ retail accounts 
• Grew regional revenue by 22% year-on-year against a flat market 
• Redesigned the lead qualification process, improving conversion 
by 15% 
• Introduced a monthly performance review cadence that cut 
executive attrition by half 
Senior Sales Executive — Coastal Traders Ltd, Kozhikode 
May 2019 – Mar 2022 
• Managed a portfolio of 60+ retail accounts across 3 districts 
• Ranked #2 sales performer company-wide in 2021 out of 45 
executives 
• Negotiated exclusive shelf-placement deals with 12 key accounts 
Sales Executive — Coastal Traders Ltd, Kannur 
Jun 2015 – Apr 2019 
• Onboarded 30+ new retail partners in the first year on the job 
• Achieved 110% of assigned sales target for 3 consecutive years 
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS 
• Winner, 'Regional Manager of the Year' — Meridian FMCG 
Distributors (2023) 
• Designed a territory-mapping framework later rolled out across 3 
other regions 
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION 

• Regularly invited to mentor first-year sales executives during 
company induction
